shared_elements: schematic anthropomorphic figures with limbs extended
horizontal band of repeated linear pattern (rows of strokes / zigzag register)
incised or applied line-work on a natural stone surface
justification: Both surfaces carry schematic figural imagery on unpainted-to-lightly-worked stone, and each includes a horizontal band of repetitive strokes plus small circular/disc motifs and profile creatures, which is the most concrete correspondence. But A is a flat, ground-level field of red-filled outline drawings scattered without registers, while B is an upright pillar with carefully stacked relief registers and volumetric modelled animals — the manner of making and the compositional logic are fundamentally different.
